scenario_scope: Coordinated primary-source and manuscript-ownership triage for relational topology compilation, confidential and verifiable AI computation, human-AI symbiosis and neurotechnology, military AI and strategic stability, theoretical limits, non-silicon compute, post-quantum migration, co-adaptation, competition and liability, and multilingual/cultural coverage.

cases.decision_rationale: No existing chapter owns the joined lifecycle from dimensional typing and candidate topology through role-preserving relation persistence, qualification, adaptive order, reversible contraction, slow-path compilation, and RODIE evaluation.
promotion_blockers: no RODIE corpus or natural-task result
non_claims: does not establish irreducible high-order structure
does not prove bounded primitive arity sufficient

cases.decision_rationale: Privacy owns permitted information use and hardware custody owns artifact control; neither owns execution across distrust boundaries with explicit input privacy, model privacy, output integrity, computation correctness, attestation freshness, verifier policy, and cost.
required_before_drafting: primary-source notes for NIST PEC, RATS, and zkLLM
promotion_blockers: no local FHE, MPC, TEE, or ZK inference
cryptographic proof scope is not semantic correctness
non_claims: does not make attested code trustworthy or authorized

cases.decision_rationale: Human Factors owns oversight performance; the new owner governs longitudinal bidirectional coupling in which cognitive state, neural data, adaptation, assistive dependence, stimulation, and identity-sensitive changes become part of the system.
promotion_blockers: no local human or neural-interface study
non_claims: does not authorize neural data collection or stimulation

cases.decision_rationale: Dangerous Capabilities owns actor uplift and misuse measurement. Military and nuclear systems require a separate interaction-level lifecycle for context-specific human judgment, command authority, target and effect constraints, adversary response, false alarms, crisis timing, escalation, proliferation, legal review, and fail-safe posture.
promotion_blockers: no operational weapon design or test
no universal legal or strategic conclusion
non_claims: does not authorize weapons or targeting
does not establish that any specific policy is stabilizing

cases.decision_rationale: No-free-lunch and identifiability qualify Learning Theory; neuromorphic, photonic, analog, quantum, and biohybrid systems qualify Replaceable Substrates and Physical Compute; post-quantum migration qualifies Security Kernel and Weight Custody; co-adaptation qualifies Human-AI Organizations; market concentration and liability qualify Deployment and Institutions; multilingual and cultural coverage qualify Communication and Benchmarks.
promotion_blockers: literature synthesis is not local evidence
projected hardware or policy benefits are not reproduced
non_claims: does not promote any chapter core

validation_boundary: Records four distinct-owner admissions and eight existing-owner integrations after a full manifest and primary-source audit. It validates neither the new architectures nor their source-reported results, legal conclusions, military policy, human outcomes, cryptographic guarantees, or support movement.
non_claims: does not create empirical, formal, reproduced, deployed, legal, or SOTA support
does not authorize hazardous or human-subject experimentation
does not close the active empirical roadmap
